effort: none: pi 1.6.0 --thinking clamps a level the model can't take to another level with no warning or error (packages/ai/src/models.ts clampThinkingLevel, earendil-works/pi v1.6.0)
login: pi's own login, saved by `pi auth login <provider>` in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json, or a provider API-key variable you set yourself
daemon: pi's bash tool runs each command in its own process group, so a command it backgrounds can outlive the turn; stop ends it with the process tree
